newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: New S.African oil industry chief expects changes.
newsitem.headline: New S.African oil industry chief expects changes.

text.p: A new dispensation for the South African liquid fuels industry will hopefully be concluded this year, the new industry chief Dennis Poole said on Tuesday.

Poole, managing director of Total South Africa, has been appointed chairman of the South African Petroleum Industry Association. He succeeded Caltex Oil (SA) (Pty) Ltd chairman and Managing director Mike Rademeyer.
Poole said he was confident that 1997 "will prove to be the year in which progress will be made toward agreeing and implementing a new dispensation for the liquid fuels industry."

The industry has been pressing for some time for the deregulation of the tightly controlled industry and took heart this week by a commitment by Deputy Minerals and Energy Affairs mInister Susan Shabangu to complete the process by the end of 1997.
